dashboard.name: GPCP Daily v3.3: Global Precipitation Climatology Project
dashboard.precipitation_basis: Satellite + gauges; constrained to GPCP monthly
dashboard.update_status: Ongoing; updated monthly, with a processing delay.
dashboard.notes: Merged satellite and gauge analysis: IMERG V07 Final (V07 Late for October–December 2025), GridSat infrared and GPCC gauges, constrained to the GPCP monthly analysis. Computed at the University of Maryland and archived at NOAA NCEI. Replaces the 1° V1.3 One-Degree Daily product.

identification.full_name: NOAA Climate Data Record (CDR) of the Global Precipitation Climatology Project (GPCP) Daily Version 3.3
identification.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
identification.description: A global gridded daily precipitation product that combines satellite observations and surface gauge measurements. V3.3 is the latest documented version; the older One-Degree Daily product (V1.3) is at 1° and begins in October 1996.

instruments.summary: Passive microwave radiometers, infrared imagers, GPM constellation sensors (through IMERG) and GPCC rain gauges

categories.name: GPM constellation sensors
categories.role: Satellite precipitation estimates brought in through IMERG

categories.name: Geostationary infrared (IR) imagers
categories.role: Cloud characteristics and precipitation estimates from IR brightness temperatures

categories.name: GridSat IR
categories.role: Extends daily coverage back to January 1998

categories.name: Rain gauges (GPCC)
categories.role: Ground-based observations for calibration and merging

instruments.note: A merged satellite-and-gauge product, not a single instrument. Some entries are instrument families or data products rather than single instruments. Our own web research (GPCP part 6) found that V3.3 used IMERG V07 Late, not Final, for October–December 2025, because IMERG V07 Final ends in September 2025.

temporal.start_note: V3.3 adds GridSat infrared to start earlier than V3.2 (June 2000).
temporal.latency: Delayed processing; data are not available right after observation

status.label: Ongoing

versions.note: Daily from June 2000 to present; monthly from 1983 to present
